cards.reason: Alito contrasts an affirmative defense with an element of the claim; the card defines the term, which the whole case turns on, and notes that the Eleventh Circuit only assumed the exemption is one.

cue.heading: Pleading
cue.text: A reason that defeats a claim even if the plaintiff proves everything the claim requires. Rule 8(c) requires the defendant to state it in the answer. An element, by contrast, is part of what the plaintiff must prove. The Eleventh Circuit assumed, without deciding, that the personal-staff exemption is an affirmative defense.
cue.source: Fed. R. Civ. P. 8(c)(1); Oden (5th Cir. 2001); Pet. App. 8a
